NOVA Hybrid Irons are designed for the golfer who prefers to sweep the ball from the turf as opposed to hitting down and through and taking a divot. In 2011, David Lake designed our NOVA Hybrid Irons which were the industry's first true line of hybrid irons that combine the playability of a hybrid wood with the inherent accuracy of an iron. Since then, a few brands have copied our design but have fallen far short of the playability and forgiveness of our NOVA Hybrid Irons. As well, the combination of our NOVA Hybrid Irons and single-length play make them vastly superior in performance to any brand of hybrid irons on the market today. 

NOVA Single-Length Hybrid Irons feature the flat club face of an iron, combined with the wide sole of a hybrid wood to produce the low center of gravity and smooth turf glide of a hybrid wood. They are designed for single-length play: same length, weight, lie angle, bounce angle, and sole width throughout the set, and are completely swing-weight and MOI matched. This allows you to use the exact same set-up, swing, and ball position with every iron in your set for the ultimate in ball striking consistency.

Although hybrid woods are typically the easiest-to-play clubs in a player's bag, they incorporate the single flaw of all wood-type clubs: bulge and roll built into the club face. For those not familiar with these terms, they relate to the curvature of the club face from toe to heel and sole to top line. The presence of bulge and roll on a club face makes it impossible to attain any level of distance or accuracy control that you would normally associate with iron play. With a hybrid wood, you aim for the width and depth of a green, whereas with an iron, you aim at the pin. 

The big distinction is that NOVA Single-Length Hybrid Irons are just that – irons, which means you not only enjoy the playability and added distance of a hybrid wood but also the precise distance control and unparalleled accuracy of an iron. They are without a doubt the easiest to play, most consistent, and most accurate hybrids on the market today.

NOVA Single-Length Hybrid Irons are custom-built to your ideal club length based upon your wrist-to-floor measurement. They are identical throughout the set except for the clubface loft angle. It is like playing an entire round of golf with only a single iron.

NOVA Single-Length Hybrid Irons are the only custom-fitted hybrid irons in the golf industry designed specifically for single-length play and whose specifications include:

  • Identical club length throughout the set.
  • Identical clubhead lie angle throughout the set.
  • Identical swing-weight and moment of inertia (MOI) throughout the set.
  • Identical shaft flex and flex plane alignment throughout the set.
  • Custom fit - all NOVA Hybrid Irons are custom fitted to the individual golfer.

SHAFTS & GRIPS:

  • NOVA Single-Length Hybrids are shafted with a specialized frequency-balanced, 100% graphite shaft specifically designed to accommodate all swing speeds. The result is a lightweight hybrid iron and wood, custom-fitted for club length, that promotes higher swing speeds and more forgiveness.
  • Identical club length throughout the set.
  • Identical clubhead lie angle, swing weight and (MOI), and shaft flex throughout the set.
  • Shaft flex plane orientation (Spine Align/Puring).
  • All Irons and Woods are installed with 1/8" oversized grips for superior control and transfer of swing force.

GRIA Hybrid Woods: 

  • Built to a 40" club length with a highly cambered sole that is designed to fit any size golfer.

Dark Horse Driver:

  • Is custom-built to your ideal club length based upon your wrist-to-floor measurement.

title: One Iron Golf Cat's Paw Putter
body_html:
Introducing the NEW One Iron Golf Cat's Paw Putter!

Our One Iron Golf Cat's Paw putter forces you to hit the putt on your precise line. There is zero toe or heel face deflection, which is unlike all longer faced putters that will deflect unless you hit the ball dead center, causing an off-line putt without you even knowing it. CNC milled out of solid brass produces a heavier clubhead that eliminates any wobbling tendency throughout your putting stroke for pure solid putts every time. Incorporates a 0º loft angle for straight putts with no initial hopping of the ball, common to all other putters. The One Iron Golf Putter can be played either right-handed or left-handed. Built to a 35” club length to force you to position your eyes directly over the ball throughout your stroke for precision putting. This is the last putter you will ever own!

Length: 35.5”
  • Lie angle: 70º
  • Loft Angle: 0º
  • Clubhead weight: 304 grams
  • Grip weight: 155 grams
  • 360º clubhead balance = 0º face deflection
  • Play in Right or Left Hand
  • Limited Edition

A cat never misses the mouse and the Cat's Paw never misses the line!

Start sinking putts from all over the green and watch your friends' jaws drop! 

Complement your One Iron Golf Putter with the 1 Iron Dark Horse Driver - Improve your game from beginning to end: 1 Iron Dark Horse Driver
